notes: The two articles of הָאֲנָשִׁים הָאֵלֶּה are unrepresented: the ASV writes one determiner, *these*, and the written demonstrative pronoun licenses it (rule 41's limit).
*should* goes to the interrogative הֲ under rule 17, leaving *I be inquired of* to the finite Niphal.
*at all* is taken as the infinitive absolute's distinct intensifier under rule 56, headed on *all*; the competing reading folds it into the finite verb's rendering.
